bullets.id: Emas menembus $4.000 pada Jumat: Kitco mencatat emas di sekitar $3.995,81, turun 0,70%, dan perak turun 1,26% ke sekitar $53,90. Penutupan New York di $4.000,14 berarti emas turun $160,96 atau 3,87% dalam sepekan. Brent naik di atas $117, tertinggi lebih dari empat tahun, karena ketegangan di Selat Hormuz.
bullets.en: Gold broke $4,000 on Friday: Kitco had gold near $3,995.81, down 0.70%, and silver down 1.26% at about $53.90. The New York close of $4,000.14 leaves gold down $160.96, or 3.87%, on the week. Brent rose above $117, its highest in more than four years, on Strait of Hormuz tension.

bullets.id: Data AS menambah tekanan: PMI komposit awal Oktober 57,6 (dari 58,4) dengan manufaktur naik ke 56,0, dan ekspektasi inflasi setahun University of Michigan naik ke 4,7%. Yield Treasury 10 tahun di sekitar 5,0% dan indeks dolar sekitar 101,75. CME FedWatch memberi peluang kenaikan Fed sekitar 10% untuk Oktober dan sekitar 80% untuk Desember. Emas turun 6,57% sebulan dan sekitar 28,8% di bawah rekor $5.608,35.
bullets.en: US data added pressure: the preliminary October composite PMI was 57.6 (from 58.4) with manufacturing up to 56.0, and University of Michigan year-ahead inflation expectations rose to 4.7%. The 10-year Treasury yield is near 5.0% and the dollar index about 101.75. CME FedWatch puts the odds of a Fed hike at about 10% for October and about 80% for December. Gold is down 6.57% on the month and about 28.8% below its $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: Level dari Kitco: resistance $4.075; support $3.963, lalu $3.946, dengan target turun lebih dalam $3.890. Agenda pekan depan: rapat Fed 27–28 Oktober dengan keputusan Rabu 28 Oktober, lalu data inflasi PCE September pada Kamis 29 Oktober.
bullets.en: Kitco’s levels: resistance at $4,075; support at $3,963, then $3,946, with a deeper downside target of $3,890. Next week’s agenda: the October 27–28 Fed meeting with the decision on Wednesday, October 28, then September PCE inflation data on Thursday, October 29.

bullets.id: Harga resmi Antam terakhir Rp2.540.000/gram dengan buyback Rp2.335.000 (23 Oktober). Beberapa media melaporkan harga stabil pada Sabtu, tetapi situs Logam Mulia sedang pemeliharaan, sehingga panel Antam belum diperbarui. Galeri24 turun Rp21.000 ke Rp2.478.000 (buyback Rp2.335.000, spread sekitar 5,8%) dan UBS turun Rp23.000 ke Rp2.501.000 (buyback Rp2.310.000, spread sekitar 7,6%).
bullets.en: Antam’s last official price is Rp2,540,000/gram with a Rp2,335,000 buyback (October 23). Several outlets report it unchanged on Saturday, but the Logam Mulia site is under maintenance, so the Antam panel has not been updated. Galeri24 fell Rp21,000 to Rp2,478,000 (buyback Rp2,335,000, spread about 5.8%) and UBS fell Rp23,000 to Rp2,501,000 (buyback Rp2,310,000, spread about 7.6%).
